title: AI training for solopreneurs | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop on participants' own documents and tools. $1,000 per person, 5-person minimum, guide and 30-day follow-up included.
h1: Team AI training for solopreneurs and independent professionals
intro: Independent professionals rarely have anyone to learn a new tool from. Many already pay for ChatGPT, Claude, or Google Gemini, use it for the occasional email, and have not connected it to the documents they produce every week: proposals, session notes, client updates, invoices, and marketing copy. The tools sit alongside Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Canva, and Mailchimp without a defined place in the workflow. Training applies wherever the owner writes the same kind of document repeatedly and wants a reliable process for producing it.

Creosote Labs runs the workshop in one day, on site or remote, in the AI tool each participant already uses. The session has a 5-person minimum, so one-person businesses can fill it with the people they work alongside: a bookkeeper, a virtual assistant, subcontractors, or other independent professionals. Each participant works on their own computer with their own files and leaves with a working setup and a written record of their process. A written guide and a 30-day follow-up session are included. The fee is $1,000 per person.
projects: A proposal template in Claude or Gemini that drafts a scope and price from the participant's own discovery call notes.
A client update routine that turns a week's work log into a short progress email in the participant's voice.
A session-notes process for coaches and therapists in private practice that produces a summary from rough notes.
A newsletter workflow that drafts a Mailchimp issue from the participant's recent posts and client questions.
A written guide, produced by each participant during the day, describing their own setup step by step.

faqs.q: How does a one-person business meet the 5-person minimum?
faqs.a: Participants do not need to work for the same company. A solopreneur can bring the contractors, assistants, or other independent professionals they work with, and the fee is $1,000 per person.

faqs.q: Which AI tool is the workshop taught in?
faqs.a: It is taught in the tool each participant already uses, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, or Microsoft 365 Copilot. We confirm access and accounts before the session so the day is spent on real work.

faqs.q: What is included after the workshop day?
faqs.a: A written guide for the group and a 30-day follow-up session are included. A program with three monthly follow-up sessions is available at $1,400 per person.
